items.item_text: Previous hospital experience.

In this role you will perform duties to support the Santa Monica Hospital distribution of supplies, equipment, and linen as assigned within UCLA Health. You will work closely with patient care units as a liaison between the staff and Materials Management to ensure that the clinical department's supply needs are being met.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Order supplies using various databases and track inventory levels
Receive and transport shipment; reconcile packing slips against delivered content
Provide customer service to staff who come to the issuing window for pick-up
Pick supplies and deliver content for medical cases
Conduct daily equipment rounds including clean, sterilize, and prepare equipment
Additionally, this position may be cross-trained in other areas to support departmental needs.
This is a part-time per diem (as needed) position with variable working hours and schedule. May convert to Career.
Able to push/pull up to 100 pounds and lift up to 50 pounds.

Provide information regarding proper sterilization techniques, product information, equipment operation etc. to fellow staff and other healthcare team members, serving as a resource for people needing direction as required.
Consistently demonstrates a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Always ensures a safe, clean working environment for self and co-workers. Monitors and reports unsafe acts or conditions and assists with resolutions.
Consistently maintains good guest relations; demonstrates good communication etiquette.
Maintains a positive attitude and behavior. Efficient with time utilization/productive, strives to be a team member, prompt attitude, adapts to change in workload, adapts to variable rotating shifts.
Skilled in the English language in both written and verbal format; good comprehension of written and verbal instruction.
Knowledge of Hospital Mainframe and Lawson/INFOR Systems.
Ability to strictly obey healthcare regulations for infection control, as well as departmental and UCLA Policies and procedures.
Ability to attend and participate in all requested classes/drills/programs/workshops.
Ability to assist in the orientation and skill development of new staff members.
